description: The original 100 questions plus two independently labeled 50-question sets. The newer 50 were written after the Jev date-choice criteria were frozen, use no calendar years, and keep the same gold entity, target, metric, and coarse date fields.
scoring: One point per question only if entity set, target entity, metric ID, and coarse date label all match; otherwise zero. Absolute year numbers and fiscal/calendar basis are ignored.
